articles.Title: A team of superstars, not a superstar team: Why Mumbai Indians’ core failed to click in IPL 2026
articles.Description: The Mumbai Indians, a team built around the core of India's T20 World Cup champions, faced an early elimination in IPL 2026. Despite their individual brilliance, the players, seemingly fatigued from their international triumph, struggled to unite as a cohesive unit, leading to fan frustration and questions about the team's future.

articles.Title: India shaping global thinking on digital finance: PK Mishra
articles.Description: India is leading global digital finance discussions. Its digital public infrastructure is being studied worldwide. The Unified Payments Interface democratizes finance. The JAM Trinity has facilitated massive financial transfers and governance savings. Schemes like Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana support marginalized groups. These initiatives are driven by strong policy and political will. Modern finance must remain linked to the real economy.
